title: Selective 1,2-addition of acetonitrile/acetone to α,β-unsaturated aldehydes at room temperature: access to cinnamyl alcohol derivatives with potential protective effects against exercise-induced skeletal muscle injury
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29598-29602
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01217E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shibo Ma, Yanlin Zhang, Yonghui He
An electrocatalytic selective 1,2-addition of acetonitrile/acetone to α,β-unsaturated aldehydes at room temperature was developed, providing 38 cinnamyl alcohol derivatives in mild reaction conditions.
